brief.claim: Giving the compound in the drinking water reduces body-weight gain: the mean weight gain of animals receiving the compound is lower than that of controls, and a Welch two-sample t test of the difference between the two group means gives two-sided p < 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: body-weight gain in grams over the study of each animal housed in each cage
whether the drinking water supplied to the cage contained the compound

brief.sizes: cages = 40; animals = 2 (weight_gain: 40 x 2 = 80 values; treated: 40 values)
